report your observations to the National Weather Service office in
Rapid City via phone, email, or social media, as soon as it is safe
to do so.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Palm Canyon.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1045 PM MST FOR SOUTHEASTERN LA PAZ AND NORTH CENTRAL YUMA COUNTIES

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 11 at 1:03AM EDT until August 11 at 1:45AM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
SVRCTP

The National Weather Service in State College PA has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South central Somerset County in south central Pennsylvania...

* Until 145 AM EDT.

* At 102 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Grantsville,
moving east southeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Meyersdale, Mount Davis, Salisbury, Wellersburg, and Callimont.
properties.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this severe
thunderstorm. Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's
leading killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close
enough to be struck by lightning.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 11 at 1:14AM EDT until August 11 at 4:15AM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
FFWCTP

The National Weather Service in State College has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southwestern Somerset County in south central Pennsylvania...

* Until 415 AM EDT.

* At 114 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Meyersdale, Ursina, New Centerville, Mount Davis, Rockwood,
Confluence, Salisbury, Garrett, Addison, Wellersburg, Casselman,
Callimont and Seven Springs.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 9:53PM MST until August 10 at 10:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
SVRPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
East central La Paz County in west central Arizona...

* Until 1045 PM MST.

* At 953 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 21 miles southeast
of Vicksburg Junction, or 38 miles west of Tonopah, moving
northwest at 15 mph.

HAZARD...70 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect considerable
tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to mobile homes,
roofs, and outbuildings.

* Locations impacted include...
Vicksburg, Vicksburg Junction, Harcuvar, and Salome.

This includes the following highways...
AZ Interstate 10 between mile markers 33 and 60.
US Highway 60 between mile markers 37 and 54.
AZ Route 72 between mile markers 46 and 49.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
